requirements.quote: Share a brief or handover as a secure, expiring link: the recipient views it and is invited to join, with the matter offered for import into their own workspace.
Share a brief or handover as a secure, expiring link
requirements.why: Conflicts with #71 internal-only acceptance criterion; needs product decision and the handover entity (#71 open)

requirements.quote: Referral credits in `packages/billing` (a free month for both sides) and abuse limits.
Funnel metrics: invites sent, accepted and activated.
A shared brief link works for a non-user, expires, and converts to a sign-up with the referral credited. [type:e2e]
requirements.evidence: Playwright e2e runs in CI (ship PRs and nightly); in lane covered by integration tests V1

requirements.quote: No matter data is visible beyond the shared item, and links can be revoked. [type:integration]

createBriefShare (assembleBrief snapshot, hashed 32-byte token, TTL, rate limit), revokeBriefShare, viewBriefShare (public, token only, returns snapshot only), importSharedMatter, recordShareAccepted; cross-tenant registry entries and cases; CORE_DOMAIN_DEPENDENCIES + docs/engineering/core-domains.md
grantReferralCredit (free month both sides, idempotent per invitee, per-referrer cap and self-referral denial) exported via index, with tests

public read-only brief view, expired/revoked/invalid states, sign-up CTA carrying referral, import offer after sign-in; owner share/revoke 'use server' actions registered in apps/web/__tests__/cross-tenant-actions.test.ts; i18n namespace + catalog test
funnel counts for invites sent, accepted, activated (channel referral); surface on apps/admin/app/(console)/growth/page.tsx
integration tests: non-user view, expiry, revoke, no data beyond snapshot, rate limit, referral credited once

preserve.what: assembleBrief behaviour and its read-only barrel packages/core/src/briefs/index.ts (no export function added there)
Existing activation_event steps/channels in packages/db/src/schema/activation.ts (additive only)
